# The Trade Desk Data Access Portal
> Privacy portal for managing advertising data choices, including cookie, device, app, and identifier opt-outs.

The Trade Desk Data Access Portal helps individuals control how advertising data associated with their browser, device, or identifiers is used. It focuses on privacy rights, opt-out mechanisms, and links to relevant industry privacy resources.

## Main Portal
- [Data Access Portal](https://www.adsrvr.org/): Main privacy portal for controlling personal information and advertising data preferences.
- [Control Over Your Personal Information](https://www.adsrvr.org/): Overview of available privacy controls and data access choices.
- [Cookie Based Opt-Out](https://www.adsrvr.org/): Information about opting out of cookie-based advertising data use.
- [Industry Opt Out Pages](https://www.adsrvr.org/): Links to industry-wide advertising opt-out resources.
- [Device/Apps Opt Out](https://www.adsrvr.org/): Guidance for opting out on mobile devices and applications.
- [Opting Out of Other Identifiers](https://www.adsrvr.org/): Instructions for managing opt-outs tied to other advertising identifiers.

## Cookie and Browser Controls
- [Data Access Portal](https://www.adsrvr.org/): Browser-based controls for managing cookie-related advertising preferences.
- [Cookie Based Opt-Out](https://www.adsrvr.org/): Details on how cookie opt-outs work and their browser-specific limitations.
- [Control Over Your Personal Information](https://www.adsrvr.org/): Explains how browser settings affect advertising data controls.

## Mobile and Device Opt-Out
- [Device/Apps Opt Out](https://www.adsrvr.org/): Mobile operating system and app-level advertising opt-out guidance.
- [Control Over Your Personal Information](https://www.adsrvr.org/): Summary of privacy options available across devices and environments.
- [Opting Out of Other Identifiers](https://www.adsrvr.org/): Additional identifier-based controls beyond cookies and mobile ad IDs.

## Industry Resources
- [Industry Opt Out Pages](https://www.adsrvr.org/): Central section linking to broader industry advertising opt-out programs.
- [Data Access Portal](https://www.adsrvr.org/): Starting point for accessing Trade Desk and industry privacy resources.
- [Control Over Your Personal Information](https://www.adsrvr.org/): Context for how portal controls relate to industry opt-out tools.

## Identifier-Based Privacy Choices
- [Opting Out of Other Identifiers](https://www.adsrvr.org/): Guidance for opting out using identifiers other than cookies or device IDs.
- [Control Over Your Personal Information](https://www.adsrvr.org/): Explains the scope of identifier-based privacy controls.
- [Data Access Portal](https://www.adsrvr.org/): Entry point for reviewing available identifier-related privacy options.
